stem: Meena plants a bean seed in a small pot at her home in Pune. She watches the plant over many weeks. Which list shows the stages of the bean plant life cycle in the correct order?

options.text: seed → germination → leaves → flowers → pods with seeds → plant dies
seed → germination → leaves → pods with seeds → flowers → plant dies
seed → germination → leaves → flowers → life cycle is complete
seed → germination → flowers → leaves → pods with seeds → plant dies

teacher.key_rationale: The bean life cycle runs seed → germination → leaves → flowers → pods (fruit) with seeds → death of the plant, so A is correct. B reverses flowers and pods, C omits the pod/seed stage needed to continue the cycle, and D puts flowers before leaves.
